dialogues.speaker: Ikalainen
dialogues.text: Sorry, I've got to watch the conveyor belt. Can't afford any distractions...

dialogues.speaker: Ikalainen
dialogues.text: It would be fair to say this conveyor belt is the lifeblood of Nasha Town!

dialogues.speaker: Ikalainen
dialogues.text: It starts at the harbor and makes a full loop of the town. Pretty much all our supplies and trade — even the daily lives of the town's residents — depend on it.

dialogues.speaker: Ikalainen
dialogues.text: Recently, the section that enters the harbor's been out of service. The supplies are piling up, and people are having to move things by hand — it's a real tough job...

dialogues.speaker: Ikalainen
dialogues.text: Huh, those goods just went by in a flash... I didn't miss anything that needs unloading, did I?
